prompt.project_info: Clean vibrant travel-influencer portrait on a Maldives-style tropical beach.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long loose platinum-blonde beach waves, gentle tan and relaxed confident expression, looking back over her shoulder toward camera; wearing a matte black string bikini with triangle top and side-tie bottoms, fine white sand on forearms and legs.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 low-angle rear-side portrait, subject lying on stomach/side and supported on straight arms, torso turned toward camera; pristine white sand, turquoise water, overwater bungalows and palms behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft bright natural daylight with even illumination, airy water color and gentle shadows, clean vibrant tropical resort mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end digital photography, sharp subject focus, shallow depth of field softly blurring distant bungalows, natural perspective and realistic sand/skin texture.
